patthana12.11:5.1: Nacittasampayuttaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nacittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana12.11:7.1: Nacittasahabhuṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nacittānuparivattiṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nacittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nacittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nacittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana12.11:8.1: Naajjhattikaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nabāhiraṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana12.11:10.1: Naupādinnaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naanupādinnaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
